summary: Verified Careers banner centering fix on /welcome page. The fix correctly centers the banner content at desktop widths < 1480px (including 1365px and 1440px which were the complaint widths). All 6 tested viewports (390, 768, 1180, 1365, 1440, 1479) show body center delta of 0px with balanced left/right spacing. No horizontal overflow detected at any width.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix correctly implemented: shouldCenterCareersBanner threshold raised from 1180px to 1480px
careersContentMaxWidth properly bounds content width at different breakpoints (1120/920/640px)
welcome-careers-body wrapper uses alignSelf: center for proper centering
Actions row uses justifyContent: center when shouldCenterCareersBanner is true
context_for_next_testing_agent: Careers banner centering fix verified. The shouldCenterCareersBanner threshold was raised to 1480px to keep content centered at common desktop widths like 1365px and 1440px. The fix uses a bounded careersContentMaxWidth and alignSelf: center on the welcome-careers-body wrapper.

desktop_1365.note: This was the specific width mentioned in the user complaint - now properly centered

desktop_1480_boundary.note: At 1480px, centering correctly switches off (shouldCenterCareersBanner = width < 1480)

user_complaint_assessment.original_complaint: Welcome section Careers banner left aligned instead of centered at desktop widths like 1365px
user_complaint_assessment.root_cause: shouldCenterCareersBanner was disabled too early at 1180px, causing left-weighted content at widths 1180-1479px
user_complaint_assessment.fix_applied: Raised shouldCenterCareersBanner threshold to 1480px and added bounded careersContentMaxWidth with centered wrapper
user_complaint_assessment.verification: At 1365px: bodyCenterDelta=0px, leftFreeSpace=223px, rightFreeSpace=223px - perfectly centered
